evidence.title: 日本株ETFが今年そろって2桁上昇、00951は受益者数が4836人急増で首位
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 日本株の強気相場が続き、日経225は年初来27.05%上昇とアジア3位の強さとなり、台湾国内の日本株ETF9本の年初来リターンはすべて2桁に達した。 [e006:f02] 半導体に特化した台新日本半導体（00951）と中信日本半導体（00954）はいずれも3割超の上昇で運用成績の1、2位を占め、うち00951は受益者数が年初来4836人増えて同種別で首位となった。 [e006:f03] 日本半導体製造装置協会（SEAJ）は2026年度の装置販売額見通しを6兆6000億円へ上方修正し、前年比26%増で過去最高となる見込み。 [e006:f04] 日本株は1年超にわたる強気相場で度々最高値を更新し、台湾の投信会社が設定する日本株ETFの運用成績も押し上げている。 [e006:f05] 台湾国内の日本株ETF9本は年初来リターンがそろって2桁台に乗り、このうち半導体関連に絞った台新日本半導体（00951）と中信日本半導体（00954）はそろって3割超の上昇で成績の1、2位を独占した。 [e006:f06] 受益者数でみると、00951は年初来で4836人増え、同種別の商品の中で首位となり、成績と人気の両面で首位に立った。 [e006:f07] この日本株の活況は、政策面と産業面の2つの力が同時に働いた結果だ。 [e006:f08] 10月28日時点で、日経225は年初来27.05%上昇し、アジア主要株式市場で台湾、韓国に次ぐ3位となっている。 [e006:f09] 日本株ETFの年初来成績と受益者数の変化は以下の通り。 [e006:f10] 項目 データ 台湾の投信会社が設定する日本株ETFの本数 9本 年初来リターン すべて2桁以上 成績上位2本 台新日本半導体（00951）、中信日本半導体（00954）、いずれも3割超の上昇 00951の受益者数増加（年初来） 4836人増、同種別で首位 日経225の年初来上昇率（10/28時点） 27.05%、アジア3位 注：データは2026年10月27日時点。 [e006:f11] 注目すべきは、世界の半導体市場が足元で激しく変動し、地政学的不確実性も投資心理を引き続き揺さぶるなか、受益者数の流れを見ると日本半導体テーマは依然として資金の集まる先であり、00951と00954の増加人数は上位に入っている点だ。 [e006:f12] 日本は世界の半導体の要衝であり、需要急増に押されて日本半導体製造装置協会（SEAJ）は2026年度の日本半導体装置販売額見通しを6兆6000億円へ大幅に上方修正した。 [e006:f13] 前年比26%増で過去最高を更新する見込みで、2026年から2028年までの年平均成長率（CAGR）は13.8%と予測している。 [e006:f14] 同氏はまた、足元で各半導体装置サプライヤーの利益が概ね上方修正されていることは、AI時代の演算能力需要の大幅な高まりを反映するとともに、先端半導体プロセス向け装置の需要が引き続き強まっていることを裏付けると述べた。 [e006:f15] 投信会社の運用担当者は、日本半導体市況は足元で世界のテクノロジー株調整に伴い目立って下落したが、長期投資家にとってはむしろ押し目買いの余地を生み出したと分析する。 [e006:f16] 総じてみれば、日本株ETFの年初来リターンは全面的に2桁台に乗り、日本株の強気相場と半導体テーマの二重の追い風を反映している。

ASEAN labour statistician network launched ahead of Singapore’s 2027 chairmanship
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Stronger cooperation in labour statistics can help governments identify emerging workforce trends earlier. [e002:f02] Singapore will lead a new office and knowledge portal, while joint projects like the AI Exposure Index and Green Jobs Report will help members spot changes in jobs and skills earlier. [e002:f03] Experts said the network will tackle data gaps and fragmentation, build trust and continuity, and strengthen regional and international cooperation to support workers, businesses and policy makers. [e002:f04] AI generated SINGAPORE – Businesses and workers can benefit from a more coordinated system of data collection and analysis, as ASEAN member states join a new network to strengthen workforce planning across the region. [e002:f05] The ASEAN Labour Statisticians Network (ALSN), which was officially launched on Oct 27, aims to help member states identify emerging trends in jobs and skills earlier and ensure sustained cooperation among countries. [e002:f06] Singapore has been endorsed to establish and lead the network in the next five years to foster and strengthen cooperation among labour experts, statistical communities and policymakers to navigate the future of work. [e002:f07] “As the world of work evolves, our statistics must keep pace to support our policymakers,” said the Ministry of Manpower’s (MOM) Permanent Secretary Stanley Loh in his welcome address at the network’s inaugural forum held at Sheraton Towers on Oct 27. [e002:f08] He noted that as ASEAN’s labour markets differ in economic structures, demographic profiles and policy priorities, their statistical systems bring different strengths and experiences. [e002:f09] Each ASEAN country may nominate up to two focal points from relevant labour statistical or research institutions to join ALSN, and the office will work with the respective representatives to identify priorities and develop joint projects. [e002:f10] ST PHOTO: DESMOND FOO At the forum, which brought together over 150 leading labour market experts from ASEAN, MOM’s Loh also announced the launch of a regional knowledge portal. [e002:f11] Ritash Sarna, the chief statistician of the International Labour Organization, said in his keynote speech that international statistical standards do not require every country to adopt the same policy. [e002:f12] More data don’t automatically mean better evidence.” The network also launched joint incubator projects to support interested member states in developing new methods of collecting and analysing labour market information. [e002:f13] It should be reflected in whether our labour market data intelligence is improving and becomes more effective in supporting the policymaking process.” The ASEAN Green Jobs Report, released on Oct 27, provides a regional assessment of green jobs and green skills across all 11 ASEAN member states. [e002:f14] MOM’s director of manpower research and statistics Ang Boon Heng, who also chairs ALSN, told The Straits Times that establishing the network matters to Singapore as developments across ASEAN countries affect businesses and workers. [e002:f15] “Many businesses operate across the region, and shifts in investment, production and demand for skills can influence job opportunities here,” he said, adding that Singapore also benefits from the experience and expertise of other ASEAN member states. evidence.body: [e004:f01] Eddie Muller 29 October 2026 4 min read ₿ BTC LIVE BTC price on Oct 29, 2026 at 5pm EDT $79,750 or above 1.79x 56% $80,000 or above 2.13x 47% 12:14:58 $738,078 vol 80 markets Janus Henderson and Centrifuge put the JQQQ tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar on October 27, 2026, an addition to an institutional onchain investment platform that Janus Henderson says now exceeds $1 billion. [e004:f02] The fund brings licensed Nasdaq-100 exposure to eligible professional investors outside the United States. [e004:f03] JQQQ follows the Janus Henderson Anemoy S&P 500 Fund, SPXA, introduced the previous year . [e004:f04] Sean Wasserman, Nasdaq’s head of index product management, said investors exploring digital infrastructure keep looking for exposure to established, transparent benchmarks. [e004:f05] JQQQ is structured as a segregated portfolio of a British Virgin Islands investment company. [e004:f06] For Stellar, the concrete development is another asset manager using the network to issue a traditional investment product. [e004:f12] That threshold comes on top of the fund’s professional-investor eligibility requirements. [e004:f13] Exposure to the Nasdaq-100 is indirect, and it comes without direct shareholder rights in the constituent securities. Fed keeps rates unchanged, gives little signal of next move
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves. [e002:f02] “Inflation remains elevated,” the Fed said in a statement released after its two-day policy meeting. [e002:f03] Holding off on an increase will allow “the accumulation of more information” that will help determine what policy the Fed should pursue “to ensure a timely return of inflation” to the central bank’s 2% inflation target, the statement said. [e002:f04] The Fed, led by Chairman Kevin Warsh, raised its benchmark rate last month for the first time in three years in an effort to get inflation back to its 2% target in a “timelier” manner. [e002:f05] The Fed is tasked by Congress to combat inflation, and it does so by lifting rates to slow borrowing and spending and cool price increases. [e002:f06] Two Fed officials dissented from Wednesday’s decision, with Fed governor Lisa Cook and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack voting in favor of hiking rates by a quarter point.
